verdict.rationale: The product is a desktop app built around a coding agent. Users delegate real tasks to it: the agent clones, branches, creates worktrees, commits, pushes, and opens and reviews PRs. Users can pick a model and effort level per chat, extend the agent with skills and MCP servers, and control autonomy with permission prompts or a full-permissions toggle. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably, since all evidence is first-party README material.
